notes.title: The plants and pats update
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

It’s been a while since our last update, and I want to assure you we have been busy in the background working in the game, more specifically working on our demo! We are very happy to bring it to you, but first we’ll be running a private playtest in our Discord server soon 💜✨

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44683966/4d5a3d003370c813d80fffe85ea61706ead35065.gif[/img]

Some features of our demo include:

- Changing objects colours, and sizes.
- Cosmo, a cat you can pat! <3
- Completing tasks at your own pace.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44683966/e8a843eabf17fdef812a9385ad8fc84813a6add4.gif[/img]

At the moment we are remaking our plants so they feel extra cosy and special!
I think they make the spaces feel so alive ☺️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44683966/7d6c79f3ceb9d40893077ec46d1a02363c47e4ac.gif[/img]

If you’d like to try the game before others, pet Cosmo and help us shape it into something truly magical, you can join our discord for closed playtests! 💜✨

Discord: https://discord.gg/f4A75GEK5m

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44683966/f88db512799d5e3bb58885eea90ac16c84ea8720.gif[/img]

notes.title: Our journey in 2024
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

We've been on Steam for a while now but haven't yet made a formal news announcement. So, here we are! The very first 💜✨

Firstly, we want to thank those who have been following us from when we started and also say hello to any new faces! We've been very busy and have so much to tell you about.

Design & Conjure has been in development for a year now, but things have really ramped up these last few months.

So far we’ve taken the game to Gamescom and to PAX Australia, and had an amazing reception at both - thanks so much to everyone who came by to play our demo!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44683966/dfe0b509734ba6e5077b0bd8cbd9b4b24f5e8ef6.png[/img]

We had an amazing time, got to meet lots of developers, and of course, you wonderful folks. We were delighted to see so many people enjoy our cozy little decorating game. At PAX alone you decorated over 150 versions of Dalia’s room!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44683966/116a08bad77cd6ce5f9a0cfa78ba2716035c09c6.png[/img]

We also had so many wonderful witches and wizards drop by - we’re super grateful to everyone who took a photo with their amazing outfits and our booth! 🔮📷

In the coming months we’re excited to bring all sorts of magical things to Design & Conjure, so be sure to wishlist so you can follow along! It helps us gain visibility and lets us know you’re interested in our whimsical decorating game. 

Thank you from the Tiny Kiwi team 🌼💜

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44683966/2d43453a084d77d720cae9df6b3394dd72d0716c.png[/img]
